```{r}

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Enabling parallel processing via future
library(future)
plan(multisession)

options(SBC.min_chunk_size = 5)

foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo <- bf(
  shots_made | trials(shots_taken) ~ 
    1 + mo(defender_foul_count) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | shot_movement) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | shot_distance_category) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | position) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | defender_id) +
    (1 + mo(defender_foul_count) | defensive_team_id) +
    (1 | offensive_team_id) 
)

prior_custom_vs_mo <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),  # Fixed effects, weakly regularizing
  prior(normal(0.2, 0.5), class = "b", coef = "modefender_foul_count"), # Likely positive effect, likely small
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(dirichlet(c(1, 1, 1, 1.5, 1.5)), class = "simo", coef = "modefender_foul_count1"),
  prior(lkj(2), class = "cor")
)

generator_foul_binomial_formula_vs_mo_custom_prior <- SBC_generator_brms(formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = small_sim_factor, prior = prior_custom_vs_mo, backend = "cmdstanr", 
                                thin = 50, warmup = 10000, refresh = 2000,
                                out_stan_file = file.path("05_1_models/brms-generator_binomial_vs-mo_custom-priors.stan")
                                )
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
# Function to analyze multiple players
analyze_players <- function(player_ids) {
  # Get comprehensive player info (including all skills and effects)
  player_info <- small_sim_unsummarized |>
    filter(defender_id %in% player_ids) |>
    group_by(defender_id) |>
    summarise(
      defender_name = first(defender_name),
      position = first(position),
      team_id = first(team_id),
      team_name = first(team_name),
      defensive_skill = first(defensive_skill),
      player_defensive_effect = first(player_defensive_effect),
      position_foul_effect = first(position_foul_effect),
      defensive_rating = first(defensive_rating),
      offensive_rating = first(offensive_rating),
      avg_foul_count = mean(defender_foul_count),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Distance analysis for all players
  distance_analysis <- small_sim_unsummarized |>
    filter(defender_id %in% player_ids) |>
    group_by(defender_id, shot_distance_category) |>
    summarise(
      shots_faced = n(),
      shots_made = sum(shot_made),
      shots_made_pct = mean(shot_made),
      avg_foul_count = mean(defender_foul_count),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    # Join with player info
    left_join(player_info, by = "defender_id") |>
    arrange(defender_id, shot_distance_category)
  
  # Foul count analysis for all players
  foul_analysis <- small_sim_unsummarized |>
    filter(defender_id %in% player_ids) |>
    group_by(defender_id, defender_foul_count) |>
    summarise(
      shots_faced = n(),
      shots_made = sum(shot_made),
      shots_made_pct = mean(shot_made),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    # Join with player info
    left_join(player_info, by = "defender_id") |>
    arrange(defender_id, defender_foul_count)
  
  # Combined distance and foul count analysis
  combined_analysis <- small_sim_unsummarized |>
    filter(defender_id %in% player_ids) |>
    group_by(defender_id, shot_distance_category, defender_foul_count) |>
    summarise(
      shots_faced = n(),
      shots_made = sum(shot_made),
      shots_made_pct = mean(shot_made),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    # Join with player info
    left_join(player_info, by = "defender_id") |>
    arrange(defender_id, shot_distance_category, defender_foul_count)
  
  # Create distance comparison plot with detailed player info in title
  distance_plot <- ggplot(distance_analysis, 
                         aes(x = shot_distance_category, 
                             y = shots_made_pct, 
                             fill = paste0(defender_id, " (", position, ", ", team_name, ")"))) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(shots_made_pct * 100, 1), "%\n(", 
                                shots_made, "/", shots_faced, ")")),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
              vjust = -1.5, size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = "Defensive Performance by Shot Distance",
      subtitle = "Percentage of shots made when defended",
      x = "Shot Distance Category",
      y = "Shot Success Rate",
      fill = "Player (Position, Team)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Create foul count comparison plot with detailed player info in facets
  foul_plot <- ggplot(foul_analysis, 
                     aes(x = defender_foul_count, 
                         y = shots_made_pct, 
                         color = paste0(defender_id, " (", position, ")"))) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(shots_made_pct * 100, 1), "%\n(", 
                                shots_made, "/", shots_faced, ")")),
              vjust = -1, size = 3) +
    ylim(0,1) +
    labs(
      title = "Defensive Performance by Foul Count",
      subtitle = "How foul count affects shot success rate",
      x = "Defender Foul Count",
      y = "Shot Success Rate",
      color = "Player (Position)"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(paste0(
      defender_id, " (", position, ", ", team_name, ")",
      "\nDS: ", round(defensive_skill, 2), 
      ", DE: ", round(player_defensive_effect, 2),
      "\nFoul Effect: ", round(position_foul_effect, 2),
      ", Team Def: ", round(defensive_rating, 2)
    )), scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Create a combined distance and foul count plot
  combined_plot <- ggplot(combined_analysis, 
                         aes(x = shot_distance_category, 
                             y = shots_made_pct, 
                             fill = as.factor(defender_foul_count))) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(shots_made_pct * 100, 1), "%")),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(vars(paste0(
      defender_id, " (", position, ", ", team_name, ")",
      "\nDS: ", round(defensive_skill, 2), 
      ", DE: ", round(player_defensive_effect, 2)
    ))) +
    labs(
      title = "Defensive Performance by Shot Distance and Foul Count",
      subtitle = "Percentage of shots made when defended (grouped by foul count)",
      x = "Shot Distance Category",
      y = "Shot Success Rate",
      fill = "Foul Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Create an alternative combined plot with distance on x-axis and lines for foul counts
  combined_line_plot <- ggplot(combined_analysis, 
                              aes(x = shot_distance_category, 
                                  y = shots_made_pct, 
                                  color = as.factor(defender_foul_count),
                                  group = defender_foul_count)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("(", shots_faced, ")")),
              vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(vars(paste0(
      defender_id, " (", position, ", ", team_name, ")",
      "\nDS: ", round(defensive_skill, 2), 
      ", DE: ", round(player_defensive_effect, 2)
    ))) +
    labs(
      title = "Defensive Performance by Shot Distance and Foul Count",
      subtitle = "How shot distance and foul count interact (numbers show sample size)",
      x = "Shot Distance Category",
      y = "Shot Success Rate",
      color = "Foul Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Create a summary stats table for the player
  player_summary <- player_info |>
    select(
      defender_id, 
      defender_name,
      position, 
      team_name, 
      defensive_skill, 
      player_defensive_effect, 
      position_foul_effect,
      defensive_rating,
      offensive_rating,
      avg_foul_count
    )
  
  # Return all data and plots
  return(list(
    player_info = player_info,
    player_summary = player_summary,
    distance_data = distance_analysis,
    foul_data = foul_analysis,
    combined_data = combined_analysis,
    distance_plot = distance_plot,
    foul_plot = foul_plot,
    combined_plot = combined_plot,
    combined_line_plot = combined_line_plot
  ))
}

# Player 33 is a shooting guard, middle of the road defender (.73 skill in a sample where 2.5 is elite and -2.5 is worst-in-league) on a slightly below average defensive team who seems to have just happened to face teams who shot really well from 10-23 feet

player_analysis <- analyze_players(c(33, 45, 21))

print(player_analysis$player_summary)
print(player_analysis$distance_data)
print(player_analysis$foul_data)
print(player_analysis$combined_data)

ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/player_33_plot.png", plot = player_analysis$foul_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/player_33_distance_plot.png", plot = player_analysis$distance_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/player_33_comb_plot.png", plot = comb_33_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/player_33_combined_bar_plot.png", plot = player_analysis$combined_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/player_33_combined_line_plot.png", plot = player_analysis$combined_line_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

player_analysis$combined_plot
player_analysis$combined_line_plot
```

Fitting the validated model to simulated data

```{r}
foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo,
  data = small_sim_factor,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = prior_custom_vs_mo,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  file = ("foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim.rds")
)
```

```{r}
summary(foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim)
```

```{r}
foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big <- brm(
  formula = foul_binomial_formula_varying_slopes_mo,
  data = big_sim_factor,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  prior = prior_custom_vs_mo,
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 42,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  file = ("foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big_2.rds")
)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(patchwork)
library(modelr)

# Load the model if it hasn't been loaded yet
# If already loaded in environment, you can skip this
if(!exists("foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big")) {
  foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big <- readRDS("foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big_2.rds")
}

# Load the simulated data
if(!exists("big_sim_unsummarized")) {
  source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots_3.R"))
  big_sim_unsummarized <- simulate_shots(
    n_observations = 2000, 
    n_defenders = 50, 
    n_teams = 5, 
    foul_count_transform = "ordered", 
    summarize_data = "FALSE"
  )
}

posterior_draws <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big |>
  gather_draws(b_Intercept, bsp_modefender_foul_count) |>
  median_qi(.width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95))

defender_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big |>
  spread_draws(r_defender_id[defender_id,term]) |>
  filter(term == "Intercept") |>
  median_qi() |>
  select(defender_id, r_defender_id, .lower, .upper)

# Extract the monotonic effect coefficients
monotonic_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big |>
  gather_draws(simo_modefender_foul_count1[1], simo_modefender_foul_count1[2], simo_modefender_foul_count1[3], simo_modefender_foul_count1[4], simo_modefender_foul_count1[5]) |>
  median_qi() 

# Get true values from simulated data
# First, summarize the true relationship between foul count and shot probability
true_foul_effect <- big_sim_unsummarized |>
  mutate(foul_count_numeric = as.numeric(as.character(defender_foul_count))) |>
  group_by(foul_count_numeric) |>
  summarize(
    shots_taken = n(),
    shots_made = sum(shot_made),
    true_prob = mean(shot_made),
    true_logit = log(true_prob / (1 - true_prob))
  )

# Extract values for the true intercept (global mean log-odds of making a shot)
# and the true effect of fouls (average change in log-odds per foul)
true_intercept <- log(mean(big_sim_unsummarized$shot_made) / (1 - mean(big_sim_unsummarized$shot_made)))

# Calculated true monotonic effect from the simulation data
# First-differencing to get step sizes in log-odds space
true_monotonic_effect <- true_foul_effect |>
  mutate(
    diff_logit = c(NA, diff(true_logit)),
    cum_effect = cumsum(replace_na(diff_logit, 0))
  )

# Calculate true effect size (overall effect of going from 0 to 5 fouls)
true_foul_effect_size <- true_foul_effect$true_logit[6] - true_foul_effect$true_logit[1]

# Compare estimated vs true defender effects
true_defender_effects <- big_sim_unsummarized |>
  group_by(defender_id) |>
  summarize(
    true_defender_effect = first(player_defensive_effect),
    true_defensive_skill = first(defensive_skill),
    shots_taken = n(),
    shots_made = sum(shot_made),
    true_prob = mean(shot_made)
  )

# Join estimated defender effects with true values
defender_comparison <- defender_effects |>
  mutate(defender_id = as.numeric(as.character(defender_id))) |>
  left_join(true_defender_effects, by = "defender_id") |>
  # Calculate correlation
  mutate(within_ci = true_defender_effect >= .lower & true_defender_effect <= .upper)


# dataset with predicted probabilities for each foul count level
newdata <- data.frame(
  defender_foul_count = factor(0:5, ordered = TRUE),
  # Use average values for other variables or set them to reference levels
  shot_movement = "stationary",
  shot_distance_category = "10_through_23_ft",
  position = "SG",
  defender_id = "1",  # Reference defender
  defensive_team_id = "1",  # Reference team
  offensive_team_id = "2",
  shots_taken = 100  # Dummy value
)

# Get posterior predictions
pred_draws <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big |>
  add_predicted_draws(newdata = newdata, re_formula = NULL) |>
  mutate(
    foul_count = as.numeric(as.character(defender_foul_count)),
    pred_prob = .prediction / 100  # Convert to probability
  )

# Calculate mean predicted probability for each foul count
pred_summary <- pred_draws |>
  group_by(foul_count) |>
  summarize(
    mean_pred_prob = mean(pred_prob),
    lower_95 = quantile(pred_prob, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(pred_prob, 0.975)
  )

# Plot of foul count effect
# The simulation seems to be producing sensible make/miss distributions, but is producing way more 5 foul scenarios, and way fewer zero scenarios, than would be expected

p1 <- ggplot() +
  # Add true values from simulation
  geom_point(data = true_foul_effect, aes(x = foul_count_numeric, y = true_prob),
             size = 3, color = "darkred") +
  # Add model predictions with confidence intervals
  geom_line(data = pred_summary, aes(x = foul_count, y = mean_pred_prob),
            size = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_summary, 
              aes(x = foul_count, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95),
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(data = true_foul_effect, 
            aes(x = foul_count_numeric, y = true_prob, 
                label = sprintf("n=%d", shots_taken)),
            vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Foul Count Effect on Shot Success Rate",
       subtitle = "Model Estimates (blue) vs. True Values (red)",
       x = "Number of Fouls",
       y = "Probability of Shot Success") +
  theme_minimal()

# MCMC trace and density plots for key parameters
p3 <- mcmc_trace(foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big, pars = c("b_Intercept", "bsp_modefender_foul_count")) +
  labs(title = "MCMC Trace for Main Parameters")

p5 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = monotonic_effects, aes(x = as.numeric(str_extract(.variable, "\\d")), y = .value), 
             size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(data = monotonic_effects, 
                aes(x = as.numeric(str_extract(.variable, "\\d")), ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper), 
                width = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(data = monotonic_effects, 
            aes(x = as.numeric(str_extract(.variable, "\\d")), y = .value, group = 1),
            color = "steelblue") +
  # Add true monotonic effect values
  geom_line(data = true_monotonic_effect[-1,], aes(x = foul_count_numeric, y = cum_effect/max(cum_effect)), 
            color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = true_monotonic_effect[-1,], aes(x = foul_count_numeric, y = cum_effect/max(cum_effect)), 
             color = "darkred", size = 3) +
  # Add legend and labels
  labs(title = "Monotonic Effect of Foul Count",
       subtitle = "Model estimates (blue) vs True values (red dashed)",
       x = "Foul Level",
       y = "Cumulative Effect (normalized)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# simplex parameters
p6 <- mcmc_areas(foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big, 
                regex_pars = "simo_modefender_foul_count1") +
  labs(title = "Posterior Distributions for Monotonic Simplex Parameters",
       subtitle = "These control the relative steps between foul levels")

# Create a posterior distribution plot for primary parameters with true values
p7 <- mcmc_areas(foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big, pars = c("b_Intercept")) +
  # vertical lines for true parameter values
  geom_vline(xintercept = true_intercept, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = true_intercept, y = 0.8, label = "True Intercept",
           color = "darkred", angle = 0, vjust = -0.5, hjust = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Distributions with True Parameter Values",
       subtitle = "Red dashed lines show true parameter values from simulation")

ppc_plot <- pp_check(foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_sim_big, ndraws = 50) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Predictive Check",
       subtitle = "How well the model predicts the observed data")

ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/posterior_with_true_values.png", plot = p7, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "05-3_ecdf-plots/pp-check_sim.png", plot = ppc_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

(p1) / (p7 | p5)

(p3) / (p6 | ppc_plot)

```
